name: Jeff Bezos

onTheRecord.finding: Bezos Earth Fund Foundation 990-PF (FY2024): officer compensation Andrew Steer (President & Director) $817,660 + $15,560 other; Douglas Varley (Secretary) $496,611 + $49,598; Tony Chan (Treasurer thru 9/30) $408,588 + $28,726. Jeffrey Bezos and Lauren Sanchez Bezos, Directors, $0.

OECD Development Co-operation Profile: Bezos Earth Fund provided USD 51 million for development in 2023 through grantmaking, a 71% real-terms decrease vs 2022; grants were 100% of gross disbursements. (OECD DAC reporting includes recipient-country breakdowns.)

notes: IMPORTANT STRUCTURE CAVEAT: The IRS-registered 'Bezos Earth Fund Foundation' (EIN 93-1868994, exemption Jan 2024, Washington DC) is a small, newly formed 501(c)(3) private foundation: FY2024 total assets $223,491, liabilities $24.5M, net assets -$24.3M, contributions received $14.25M, charitable disbursements $13.9M; FY2023 shows $0 revenue and $13.9M expenses. This entity does NOT hold the $10B Bezos Earth Fund commitment (announced 2020, to be disbursed by 2030 per Inside Philanthropy/OECD summaries); the bulk of Earth Fund grantmaking appears to run through a non-990-filing vehicle (likely LLC/DAF structure), which is why filesUS990PF=true applies only to this small foundation and assetsBillions is near zero. The older 'Bezos Family Foundation' (EIN 91-2073258, ProPublica) is the foundation of Bezos's parents Jackie and Mike Bezos, not Jeff's personal vehicle, and was not profiled here. Forbes real-time net worth $369.6B as of 9/26/26 (page last updated Sep 15, 2026); Forbes Philanthropy Score 2.
